title: Horst — the menu as four stacked colour blocks
note: MENU (a white pill top right, which turns into CLOSE) opens a full-screen panel under the black header. The left half is the four programmes stacked as equal colour blocks, each a big link at about 144px: Festival violet #6A2ED4, Club grey #A3A3A1, Atelier red #EA3323, Park pink #ED82D1. Hovering one underlines it with a thick rule. The right half is black, split by a 1px grey rule: secondary links at 35px (About, Archive, Club Stories, Editorial, FAQ, Shop), then smaller links, outlined social pills, a search field and a newsletter form. It fades in over about 0.5s while the type rises roughly 30px into place (the frame is caught mid-fade, with the cursor trail crossing the header). Worth reusing: the section colours turn into the navigation, so the menu doubles as a map of the site.
